meanings: everybody knows that, it's common knowledge
forms: literally: even the sparrows know that

examples.sr: То [и вра́пци зна̏јӯ], не мораш да објашњаваш.
examples.en: Even the sparrows know that, you don't have to explain.

meanings: tears of joy

examples.sr: Од среће су јој потекле [су̏зе ра̏доснице].
examples.en: Tears of joy ran down her face from happiness.

meanings: close the door, were you born in a barn? (a reproach)
forms: literally: you were not born on a boat

examples.en: Close the door, were you born in a barn!

note: A parent's reproach: a boat has no door, so there is nothing to close.

key: phr:ако сви скачу с моста, хоћеш ли и ти
meanings: if everyone jumped off a bridge, would you too?

examples.sr: Ако сви [ска̏чу] с моста, хоћеш ли и ти?
examples.en: If everybody jumps off a bridge, will you jump too?

note: A parent's answer to «everybody does it».

meanings: let's go! let's do this! (excited cry)

examples.en: There's a party tonight, let's go!

note: Youth slang. Hence «гасери»: trendy people in brand-name clothes.

meanings: yellow press, tabloids

examples.sr: Та [жу̏та шта̑мпа] пише само о скандалима.
examples.en: That tabloid press writes only about scandals.

note: Also: жуто новинарство; cheap stories are «петпарачке приче» (five-para stories).

meanings: to drink like a fish, to drink heavily

examples.sr: Он [пи̏је̄ ка̏о сму̑к], сваке вечери је у кафани.
examples.en: He drinks like a fish, he's at the pub every evening.

note: Смук is a snake; an old belief says it drinks milk from cows' udders.

meanings: drunk as a skunk, hammered

examples.sr: Био је [пѝјан ка̏о ле̏тва] и једва је стајао.
examples.en: He was drunk as a skunk and could hardly stand.

note: Летва is a lath (wooden strip); it warps when soaked, like a drunk.

meanings: dead drunk

examples.en: He came home dead drunk.

meanings: to drink oneself senseless, to get blind drunk

examples.en: Last night he drank himself senseless.

meanings: to act like a real man, to man up

examples.en: Man up and admit your mistake!

note: Colloq.: neuter «мушко»/«женско» mean a man/a woman: «Она је право женско».

meanings: Wednesday is a little Friday (midweek, time to relax)

examples.sr: [Сре̏да је ма̏ли пе́так], па идемо на кафу.
examples.en: Wednesday is a little Friday, so let's go for a coffee.

meanings: to tilt at windmills, to attempt the impossible
forms: literally: to straighten the crooked Drina

examples.sr: Не трошите снагу, то је као [ѝсправљати кри̏ву Дри̏ну].
examples.en: Don't waste your energy, it's like tilting at windmills.

note: The Drina is a winding border river; it cannot be straightened.

meanings: to love wholeheartedly, to love with all one's soul

examples.en: I love you with all my heart, I don't know any other way.

note: Colloquial.

meanings: death to fascism, freedom to the people (Partisan slogan)

examples.en: Death to fascism, freedom to the people!

note: A slogan of the Yugoslav Partisans in World War II, still heard on memorial days.

meanings: is this the end of the line?

examples.en: Excuse me, is this the end of the line?

note: «је л'» is short for «је ли»; «ред» is a line, a queue.

meanings: wow! amazing! (admiration)

examples.en: What a party, it's insane!

note: Colloq. exclamation; often admiring, not only critical.

meanings: what was his name again? (when trying to recall)

examples.en: What was his name again, that actor?

note: «Беше» (imperfect of «бити») is just a filler here: «Одакле си беше?» - where are you from again?

meanings: to smoke like a chimney

examples.sr: Он [пу̏ши ка̏о Ту̀рчин] и стално кашље.
examples.en: He smokes like a chimney and coughs all the time.

meanings: to drink like a fish

examples.en: They said he drinks like a fish.

key: phr:као да је дошао из бијафре
meanings: looks very hungry, looks half-starved
forms: literally: as if he came from Biafra

examples.sr: Једе као да је [до̏шао из Би̏јафре].
examples.en: He eats as if he'd been starving for a week.

note: Refers to the famine in Biafra, a secessionist region of Nigeria, in the 1960s.

meanings: something incomprehensible, all Greek to me

examples.en: This grammar is all Greek to me.

meanings: to crush, to wipe out completely
forms: literally: to dissolve like the Bulgarian parliament

examples.en: The team crushed its opponent.

meanings: up to one's ears in debt

examples.en: He's up to his ears in debt.

meanings: feigning naivety, a wolf in sheep's clothing
forms: literally: naive as a French maid

examples.en: Don't act so innocent.

meanings: well, thanks a lot (ironic reply to an unpleasant remark)

examples.sr: [Ба̏ш ти хва́ла], мама, знаш да ме обрадујеш.
examples.en: Well, thanks a lot, Mom, you really know how to cheer me up.

note: Sarcasm: «thanks» in reply to a disservice or a tactless remark.

key: phr:није срамота не знати, срамота је не питати
meanings: there is no shame in not knowing, the shame is in not asking

examples.sr: Питај слободно: [нѝје срамо̀та не зна̏ти, срамо̀та је не пи̏тати].
examples.en: Feel free to ask: there is no shame in not knowing, the shame is in not asking.

meanings: to do something for the pleasure of it, for the love of it

examples.en: He sings in the choir just for the love of it.

meanings: reading coffee grounds

examples.sr: Моја бака верује у [га̏тање из та̏лога].
examples.en: My grandmother believes in reading coffee grounds.

meanings: oh, drop it, don't make a big deal of it

examples.en: Oh, forget it, it's no big deal.

meanings: happy slava, host (a guest's greeting on a family's saint's day)

examples.en: Happy slava, host!

note: The hostess may offer «жито» (boiled wheat): the guest crosses himself, wishes well and eats.

meanings: have a good time, enjoy yourself

examples.en: Have a great time at the concert!

note: To several people or politely: «лепо се проведите»; the reply is often «и ти».

meanings: to knock on wood

examples.en: Everything's going well, knock on wood.

note: Said while tapping wood, so as not to jinx things.

meanings: I'm going by car

examples.en: Tomorrow we're driving to the seaside.

note: «кола» (car) is plural only: instr. «колима». «колом» is from «коло» (round dance).

meanings: backwater, a place where everything is badly run

examples.sr: Ово није Европа, ово је [та̑мнӣ ви̏лајет].
examples.en: This isn't Europe, this is some dark backwater.

note: A vilayet was an Ottoman province, here Bosnia. Now an ironic image of disorder and corruption.

meanings: by the book, properly, by all the rules

examples.en: Everything was done by the book.

note: ЈУС: the Yugoslav standard, like DIN in Germany. The phrase outlived Yugoslavia.

meanings: to tap Easter eggs against each other
forms: literally: to knock oneself with eggs

examples.en: Children tap eggs against each other on Easter.

note: An Easter game: two people knock their eggs together, and the one whose shell stays whole wins.

meanings: judging by

examples.en: Judging by the clouds, it's going to rain.

note: A frozen gerund; then «по» + loc.: «судећи по изгледу», «судећи по гласу».

meanings: out of spite, on principle

examples.en: He stayed there on principle.

note: «Инат» is almost a national trait: acting «из ината» is a point of pride.

meanings: on St George's Day the hajduks (outlaws) gather

examples.en: They say: «On St George's Day the hajduks gather».

note: A saying: hajduks hid in winter, and on St George's Day, with the warmth, came out and formed bands.

meanings: how handsome you look (said with feeling)
forms: literally: how handsome you are to me

examples.sr: [Ка̀ка̄в си ми ле̑п] у том оделу!
examples.en: How handsome you look in that suit!

note: «Ми» is not 'to me' here but shows the speaker's feeling (ethical dative).

meanings: to run around like a headless chicken
forms: literally: like a fly without a head

examples.sr: Трчао је около [ка̏о му̏ха без гла̏ве].
examples.en: He was running around like a headless chicken.

note: About a flustered person who grabs at everything and finishes nothing.

meanings: I'm cold

examples.en: I'm cold, close the window!

note: Impersonal, with dat.: «зима ми/ти/му је». «Зима» also means winter; cold weather: «хладно».

meanings: I'm just looking

examples.en: - Can I help you? - I'm just looking, thanks.

note: The standard answer to a shop assistant's «Изволите?». Pattern: «да» + present.

meanings: do you have anything smaller? (smaller bills or change)

examples.sr: [Да ли и̏мате не̏што си̏тније]? Имам само хиљадарку.
examples.en: Do you have anything smaller? I only have a thousand-dinar note.

note: Asked by cashiers when given a large banknote. Answer: «Имам» or «Немам, нажалост».

meanings: that's just your horoscope (that's how it goes)

examples.sr: - Зашто увек каснимо? - [Та̀ка̄в ти је хо̏роскоп]!
examples.en: - Why are we always late? - Well, that's your horoscope!

note: A joking all-purpose answer to «why?» when there is no logical explanation.

meanings: I have an appointment (with a doctor, hairdresser)

examples.en: I have a hairdresser's appointment on Saturday.

note: «Код» + gen.: with whom: код зубара, код фризера. Booking ahead is normal.

meanings: how much is it? (price)

examples.en: How much is a kilo of strawberries?

note: Colloq. variant of «колико кошта?», used for prices at a market. Also «Пошто су јагоде?».

meanings: buy two, get one free

examples.sr: На плакату пише: [пла̏ти два̑, у̀зми три̏].
examples.en: The poster says: pay for two, take three.

note: Ad slogan: buy two, get three. Nearby words: «попуст» (discount), «распродаја» (sale), «50 посто» (50 percent).

meanings: typo, misprint

examples.en: It's just an ordinary typo.

meanings: how old are you turning?

examples.en: How old are you turning this year?

note: Said to a birthday person. Plain age: «Колико година имаш?»; birth year: «Које си годиште?».

meanings: what year were you born?

examples.en: - What year were you born? - 1975.

note: More common than «колико имаш година?» for sizing up someone's age; people compare it with their own year.

meanings: have a good time, enjoy yourselves

examples.en: Are you going to a birthday party? Have a great time!

note: A wish to people going to a party, a celebration or on vacation.

meanings: who knows, God only knows

examples.sr: [Бо̏га пи̑та̄ј] где је била све време.
examples.en: God only knows where she's been all this time.

note: Said when nobody knows the answer.

meanings: it happens (comfort after a mishap)

examples.en: - I forgot my gloves again! - It happens!

note: A sympathetic phrase: it comforts, not judges. «Шта се дешава?» is 'what's going on?' and can sound sharp, or mean 'what's new?'.

meanings: to play dumb, to act clueless

examples.en: Don't play dumb, you know everything.

note: Likewise: «правити се блесав», «правити се паметан» (to act smart).

meanings: to act on one's own, to do things one's own way, at one's own risk
forms: literally: to work on one's own hand

examples.en: He always does things his own way.

meanings: I don't feel like working, I'm not in the mood to do something

examples.en: I don't feel like working today.

note: Pattern «не + verb + ми се»: «не спава ми се» (don't feel like sleeping), «не једе ми се».

meanings: it is about, it concerns, the point is

examples.en: This concerns a very important matter.

meanings: to make a secret of something

examples.sr: Не [пра̏ви та̏јну од] тога, сви већ знају.
examples.en: Don't make a secret of it, everybody already knows.

meanings: my hair stood on end, it gave me goosebumps

examples.sr: Када сам чуо ту причу, [најѐжила ми се ко̀са].
examples.en: When I heard that story, my hair stood on end.

note: With «најежити се» alone: «најежио сам се» - I got goosebumps.

meanings: to lose consciousness, to faint

examples.en: He fainted from the heat.

note: Synonyms: «онесвестити се», «пасти у несвест». «Доћи свести» - to come to.

meanings: I'm so sorry

examples.sr: Чуо сам за твог деду, [ба̏ш ми је жа̏о].
examples.en: I heard about your grandfather, I'm so sorry.

note: Used both for condolences and for small disappointments.

meanings: please accept my condolences

examples.en: Please accept my condolences on your loss.

note: Informal, to one person: «Прими моје саучешће».

meanings: leave me alone

examples.en: Leave me alone, please.

note: Polite or plural form: «Оставите ме на миру».

meanings: that's none of your business

examples.sr: [То̑ те се не ти̏че], брини о себи.
examples.en: That's none of your business, mind your own.

note: Sounds sharp. The informal form: «То те се не тиче».

meanings: who do you root for?

examples.en: - Who do you root for? - Red Star.

note: The same question about a club: «За који клуб навијаш?».

meanings: you look good (compliment)

examples.en: You look great today!

note: Polite form: «Лепо ми изгледате». Without «ми» is also correct, but drier.

meanings: you have a really nice dress

examples.en: What a lovely dress you have!

note: Polite form: «Баш вам је лепа хаљина».

meanings: look how dressed up you are! (said to a woman)

examples.en: You're so dressed up, I'm speechless!

note: Said to a man: «скоцкао си се».

meanings: what a figure you have (compliment)

examples.en: What a slim figure you have!

note: A compliment to a woman on her slimness.

meanings: to turn someone down flat, to refuse rudely
forms: literally: to show a pomegranate (the fig sign)

examples.sr: Тражио сам помоћ, а они су ми [пока̀зали ши́пак].
examples.en: I asked for help, and they turned me down flat.

meanings: I feel sleepy, I feel like sleeping

examples.en: I've been feeling sleepy since this morning.

note: Pattern «verb + ми се»: «једе ми се», «пије ми се», «не ради ми се».

meanings: it's pouring

examples.en: It's pouring outside.

meanings: thank you very much

examples.en: Thank you very much for your help.

note: Similar: «много хвала», «пуно хвала», «захваљујем».

meanings: all the best

examples.en: Thanks, all the best!

note: A typical goodbye to a taxi driver or shop assistant: «Хвала лепо, све најбоље».

meanings: just a moment, one second

examples.sr: - Могу ли да вас питам нешто? - [Са̏мо трену́так].
examples.en: - Can I ask you something? - Just a moment.

meanings: send a car to ... (ordering a taxi)

examples.sr: [Је̏дно во̀зило у] Улицу краља Петра број пет.
examples.en: One car to King Peter Street, number five.

note: Full form: «Да ли може једно возило у ...?». You give only the street, number and entrance.

meanings: every other day

examples.en: I run every other day.

meanings: a foreigner married to a Serbian woman (said of a man)

examples.sr: Кажу да је Ајнштајн био [ср̏пскӣ зе̏т].
examples.en: They say Einstein was a Serbian son-in-law.

note: Of a woman: «српска снајка» (a foreigner married to a Serb).

meanings: every vote counts

examples.sr: Изађи на изборе, [сва̏кӣ гла̑с је би̏тан]!
examples.en: Go and vote, every vote counts!

meanings: to go to the polls, to vote

examples.en: Most citizens went to vote.

meanings: election silence, the quiet period before an election

examples.en: The pre-election silence begins at midnight.

note: Campaigning is banned during this period.

meanings: party patronage hiring, jobs given for party loyalty

examples.en: They criticize party patronage hiring in state companies.

note: A common practice: a job in the public sector comes through the party.

meanings: what a great joke, nice trick

examples.en: That joke is really great!

note: A reaction to a good joke; on April 1: «Априлилили!» (April fool).

meanings: big shot, bigwig

examples.en: That politician is a big shot.

meanings: a coincidence, a combination of circumstances

examples.sr: Све је то био само [сти̏цај при́лика].
examples.en: It was all just a coincidence.

meanings: to make an impression

examples.sr: Његов говор је [оста̀вио у̀тисак] на све.
examples.en: His speech made an impression on everyone.

meanings: to gain trust, to earn trust

examples.sr: Тешко је [сте̏ћи повере́ње], а лако изгубити.
examples.en: Trust is hard to earn and easy to lose.

meanings: I got the impression that

examples.sr: [Сте̏кла сам у̀тисак да] нас не слушају.
examples.en: I got the impression that they aren't listening to us.

note: Said by a man: «Стекао сам утисак да».

meanings: between two fires, caught in the middle

examples.sr: Био је [и̏змеђу две̑ ва̏тре], не знајући кога да подржи.
examples.en: He was caught between two fires, not knowing whom to support.

note: Also the name of a children's game, dodgeball.

meanings: Easter egg tapping (a game)

examples.en: Children love egg tapping at Easter.

note: Two people knock their eggs together; the one whose shell stays whole wins.

meanings: do you have anything for fasting? (no meat or animal products)

examples.sr: [Да ли и̏мате не̏што по̏сно] за ручак?
examples.en: Do you have anything for fasting for lunch?

note: Same set: «Да ли постите?» (are you fasting?), «Да ли је ово посно?».

meanings: for form's sake, just to be polite

examples.en: I asked her just to be polite.

meanings: it's your turn

examples.en: It's your turn, roll the die.

note: Polite form: «На вас је ред».

meanings: timetable, schedule (of buses, trains)

examples.en: Check the bus timetable.

meanings: agenda

examples.en: The new project is on the agenda.

meanings: first of all

examples.en: First of all, we need to rest.

meanings: besides that, in addition

examples.sr: [По̏ред то́га], он је и добар глумац.
examples.en: Besides that, he's also a good actor.

meanings: despite all the effort

examples.en: Despite all the effort, I didn't succeed.

meanings: now this, now that

examples.sr: Он стално мења мишљење, [ча̏с о̀во̄, ча̏с о̀но].
examples.en: He keeps changing his mind, now this, now that.

note: Pattern «час... час»: «час овамо, час онамо» - now here, now there.

meanings: at the right moment, just in time

examples.en: You came just in time.

meanings: in no time, very soon

examples.sr: Не секирај се, [за ча̏с] ћемо ово урадити.
examples.en: Don't worry, we'll do this in no time.

note: Also «за часак»: «сачекај, враћам се за часак» - wait, I'll be right back.

meanings: get well soon

examples.en: Get well soon and come back!

note: Informal, to one person: «Брзо оздрави!».

meanings: stop whining

examples.en: Stop whining, it's nothing serious.

note: Also «немој више кукати».

meanings: he (she) is on sick leave

examples.en: My colleague has been on sick leave since Monday.

meanings: I have a fever

examples.en: I have a fever, I'm staying home.

note: Also «диже се температура» (the fever is rising), «не могу да спустим температуру» (I can't bring the fever down).

meanings: I have high blood pressure

examples.en: My blood pressure has been high for days.

meanings: just listen to him (ironic)

examples.sr: [Чу̑ј га], он ће да нас учи!
examples.en: Just listen to him, he's going to teach us!

meanings: I don't even want to hear about him

examples.sr: Не прича ми о њему, [не́ћу ни да га чу̏је̄м].
examples.en: Don't talk to me about him, I won't even hear of him.

meanings: to lock up, to put under lock and key

examples.en: She locked the money away.

meanings: to make someone understand, to let someone know

examples.sr: [Ста̏вио сам му до зна̏ња] да касни.
examples.en: I let him know that he was late.

meanings: on tiptoe

examples.en: He entered the room on tiptoe.

meanings: get in touch, give me a call

examples.en: Let me know when you arrive.

note: Also «цимни ме» (colloq.) - give me a buzz.

meanings: we have to say goodbye

examples.en: We have to say goodbye to the host.

note: «Поздравити се» is both to greet and to say goodbye: «није се ни поздравио са мном».

meanings: don't bug me, don't distract me

examples.sr: [Не̏мој да ме ци̏маш], имам пуно посла.
examples.en: Don't bug me, I have a lot of work.

meanings: we didn't let you know we were coming

examples.en: We didn't let you know we were coming, sorry.

meanings: I swear to you

examples.en: I swear to you, never again.

note: More formal: «Заклињем се».

meanings: to be on pins and needles

examples.en: I was on pins and needles all evening.

meanings: I don't care

examples.en: I don't care what they think.

note: Often in a dismissive phrase: «Ма брига нас за то!» - what do we care about that.

meanings: joking aside

examples.en: Joking aside, we need to work.

meanings: I'm on the road, I'm away on a trip

examples.en: - Where are you? - I'm on the road.

note: An evasive answer: away on business, without saying where.

meanings: a baby is on the way
forms: literally: the child is on the road

examples.sr: Чула сам да [је де̏те на пу̏ту].
examples.en: I heard a baby is on the way.

meanings: to get a tan

examples.en: You got a tan!

note: A compliment after a vacation; also «баш сте поцрнели», «баш ти је леп тен».

meanings: come on, let's go

examples.en: Come on, we're late!

note: Cheering at a match: «Ајмо, ајде сви у напад!» - everyone attack!

meanings: go Serbia! (fans' chant)

examples.en: Go, Serbia!

meanings: there's everything you can think of
forms: literally: there is no what there is not

examples.en: At the market there's absolutely everything.

meanings: in case anyone isn't aware

examples.sr: Сада сам у Сокобањи, [а̏ко не̏ко не пра̏ти].
examples.en: I'm in Sokobanja now, in case anyone doesn't know.

meanings: to turn a blind eye, to overlook

examples.en: The teacher overlooks small mistakes.

meanings: to drink anything and everything

examples.en: At the party he drank anything and everything.

meanings: to answer for oneself, to be accountable

examples.en: He answers to no one.

note: «Полагати испит» - to take an exam.

meanings: sweet words, sweet talk

examples.en: He whispered sweet words to her.

meanings: fresh water

examples.en: Freshwater fish are tasty.

meanings: storks don't bring babies (babies are born to their mothers)

examples.sr: [Бра̏ћу не доно̀се ро̏де], већ их рађају мајке.
examples.en: Storks don't bring brothers, mothers give birth to them.

note: A line from a children's song; «рода» is a stork.

meanings: to cast a line, to put out feelers

examples.en: He wants to put out feelers with the director.

meanings: don't butt in

examples.sr: [Нѐмој да се убацу̀јеш], знамо шта радимо.
examples.en: Don't butt in, we know what we're doing.

meanings: don't interrupt me with remarks, don't provoke me

examples.en: Don't throw in remarks while I'm talking.

meanings: give me a ride to work

examples.sr: [О̏дбаци ме до по̀сла], ако ти је узгред.
examples.en: Drop me off at work, if it's on your way.

note: Also «Да те одбацим кући?» - shall I drive you home?

meanings: transfer me the money

examples.en: Transfer the money to my account.

meanings: I have nothing to reproach him for

examples.sr: [Не̑ма̄м шта̏ да му пре̏бацим], радио је све како треба.
examples.en: I have nothing to reproach him for, he did everything right.

meanings: what are you missing? (like 'what more do you want?')

examples.sr: Имаш посао и кућу, [шта̏ ти фа̏ли]?
examples.en: You have a job and a house, what more do you want?

meanings: from head to toe

examples.sr: Био је [од гла̏ве до пе̏те] мокар.
examples.en: He was wet from head to toe.

key: phr:говори српски да те цео свет разуме
meanings: speak Serbian so that the whole world understands you (joking saying)

examples.sr: [Го̏вори ср̏пскӣ да те це̏о све̑т ра̏зӯме]!
examples.en: Speak Serbian so the whole world understands you!

note: A well-known joke that everyone supposedly understands Serbian.

meanings: tomato tourism (ironic: bringing your own food from home)

examples.sr: Они иду на [пара̀дајз турѝзам] у Грчку.
examples.en: They're going to Greece with their own food.

note: A term from the 1980s: people brought food from home and sliced tomatoes on the beach. Now about thrifty tourists.

key: phr:ко има пара иде на море, ко нема у сутоморе
meanings: whoever has money goes to the sea, whoever doesn't goes to Sutomore

examples.sr: [Ко̏ и̏ма па̑ра и̏де на мо̑ре, ко̏ нѐма у Су̏томо̄ре].
examples.en: Those with money go to the seaside, those without go to Sutomore.

note: A joking rhyme (море / Сутоморе): Sutomore is an inexpensive Montenegrin resort.

meanings: to play «at the ear» (trumpeters play right by the ear)

examples.en: The trumpeters played right at his ear.

note: A tradition: trumpeters come up close, and are paid for it.

meanings: love at first sight

examples.sr: Била је то [љу́бав на пр̏ви по̏гле̄д].
examples.en: It was love at first sight.

meanings: butterflies in the stomach

examples.sr: Кад га видим, имам [ле̏птириће у сто̏маку].
examples.en: When I see him, I get butterflies in my stomach.

meanings: to be left breathless, to be awestruck

examples.en: I was almost left speechless by the beauty.

note: «Замало да» means 'almost'.

meanings: I couldn't resist it

examples.sr: [Ни́сам мо̏гла да му одо̀лим], купила сам га.
examples.en: I couldn't resist it, so I bought it.

note: Said by a man: «нисам могао да му одолим».

meanings: all right, okay; when paying: keep the change

examples.en: - How much is it? - Two hundred. - Keep the change.

meanings: law and order

examples.en: We want law and order.

meanings: three days in a row

examples.en: It rained three days in a row.

meanings: that's how it should be, that's the custom

examples.en: That's how it's done.

meanings: to tidy up a room, to put it in order

examples.en: I have to tidy up the room before the guest comes.

note: «Средити папире» - to get documents in order.

meanings: you matter to me, I care about you

examples.sr: [Ста̏ло ми је до те̏бе], не одлази.
examples.en: I care about you, don't leave.

note: Pattern «стало ми је до» + gen.: «до њега ми је стало».

meanings: to read palms
forms: literally: to look into the palm

examples.en: A fortune teller read my palm.

note: «Линија живота» - the life line.

meanings: I'm laughing, but I'd rather cry

examples.en: I'm laughing, but I'd rather cry.

note: A line from a well-known song.

meanings: to celebrate everything under the sun

examples.sr: Она [сла̏ви све̏ жи̑во] - сваки празник је њен.
examples.en: She celebrates everything under the sun - every holiday is hers.

key: phr:у малом граду све се зна
meanings: in a small town everybody knows everything

examples.sr: Не крији ништа, [у ма̏лом гра̀ду све̏ се зна̏].
examples.en: Don't hide anything, in a small town everybody knows everything.

note: From a song: «Мали је ово град, у њему све се зна».

meanings: don't bug me, back off

examples.en: Don't bug me, I'm busy.

note: Slang, from «смарати» (to annoy).

meanings: don't suck up to him

examples.sr: [Нѐмој да му се у̀лизујеш], остани своја.
examples.en: Don't suck up to him, stay yourself.

meanings: rain is falling, grass is growing (children's rhyme about brushing teeth)

examples.sr: Зубе перемо овако: [ки̏ша па̏да, тра́ва ра̏сте].
examples.en: This is how we brush our teeth: rain is falling, grass is growing.

note: Brush strokes top to bottom (rain falls) and bottom to top (grass grows).

meanings: I have an appointment

examples.en: I have a hairdresser's appointment.

note: For a hairdresser, doctor, restaurant: «код зубара», «код Милице».

meanings: if you've got money, you can do anything (the motto of the rich)

examples.sr: Његов мото је: [и̏ма се, мо̏же се].
examples.en: His motto: if you've got money, you can do anything.

note: A line from the rap song «Дивљина»; «има се» - one has the money.

meanings: to launder money

examples.en: They are accused of laundering money.

meanings: Prince Charming (a prince on a white horse)

examples.sr: Свака девојчица сања о [при̏нцу на бѐлом ко̏њу].
examples.en: Every little girl dreams of Prince Charming.

meanings: mama's boy

examples.en: Don't be a mama's boy, go and get it yourself.

meanings: we're going to a wedding (as wedding guests)

examples.en: On Saturday we're going to a wedding.

note: Also «идемо на свадбу» - the same, but more neutral.

meanings: don't be a child, act your age

examples.en: Don't be a child, decide for yourself.

meanings: get silly ideas out of your head
forms: literally: throw the little bugs out of your head

examples.en: Get those silly ideas out of your head and work.

meanings: a disgrace and a shame

examples.en: That's a disgrace and a shame!

meanings: don't embarrass me

examples.en: Don't embarrass me in front of the guests.

note: Also «немој да ме бламираш».

meanings: shame on you

examples.sr: [Сра̑м те би̏ло], тако се не ради!
examples.en: Shame on you, that's not how it's done!

meanings: I'm ashamed

examples.en: I'm ashamed to tell you.

note: Also «стид ме је», «стидим се».

meanings: your dress is awesome

examples.en: Your dress is awesome!

note: In youth slang «брука» means very cool.

meanings: it suits me, it's convenient for me

examples.sr: Ако ти је [зго̏дно], дођи у пет.
examples.en: If it suits you, come at five.

note: Negative: «није ми згодно».

meanings: it suits me

examples.en: This time suits me.

note: Of size, price, color, time. «Таман ми је» - it fits (size only).

meanings: I have a ton of things
forms: literally: I have a hill of things

examples.en: I have a ton of things to pack.

meanings: my back is giving me trouble (colloq.)

examples.en: My back has been giving me trouble lately.

key: phr:нека вам се свака жеља оствари
meanings: may all your wishes come true

examples.en: May all your wishes come true!

meanings: out of habit

examples.sr: Још увек устајем [по на̏вици] у шест.
examples.en: I still get up at six out of habit.

meanings: my stomach is giving me trouble (colloq.)
forms: literally: my stomach is teasing me

examples.sr: Данас ме [зе̏за] желудац, не могу да једем.
examples.en: My stomach is acting up today, I can't eat.

note: Colloq.; «зезати» is to tease, to let down. Also with other body parts: «зеза ме леђа».

meanings: my stomach is growling

examples.en: My stomach is growling from hunger.

meanings: he had a bit too much to drink
forms: literally: he drank a little more

examples.sr: Јуче је [по̀пио ма̏ло ви̏ше] па је заспао у аутобусу.
examples.en: Yesterday he had a bit too much and fell asleep on the bus.

note: «баш је попио» is the same; a mild way to say someone drank a lot.

meanings: to my taste, my kind of thing

examples.sr: Овај филм је баш [по мо̑м у̏кусу].
examples.en: This movie is just my kind of thing.

note: Changes with the person: «по твом укусу», «по његовом укусу».

meanings: to give up on someone, to wash one's hands of someone
forms: literally: to raise hands from someone

examples.en: Everybody has given up on him.

note: Often about someone nobody hopes for anymore, e.g. an incorrigible person.

meanings: I can't be bothered to, I'm too lazy to
forms: literally: it is hateful to me to

examples.en: I can't be bothered to iron.

note: Impersonal: «ме» is acc., the verb is always «мрзи». Then «да» + present.

meanings: hand on heart, honestly speaking

examples.sr: [Ру̏ку на ср̏це], није то лоша идеја.
examples.en: Honestly, that's not such a bad idea.

meanings: what can you do

examples.en: We're late, but what can you do.

meanings: to spite someone

examples.en: He did it to spite me.

note: «Инат» is stubbornness, refusal to give in; «из ината» - out of stubbornness.

meanings: I have nowhere to go

examples.en: I have nowhere to go, I'm staying here.

note: «Куд» is a short form of «куда»; usually in negation.

meanings: to make love

examples.en: Make love, not war.

meanings: to recharge one's batteries

examples.en: I recharge my batteries in the countryside.

meanings: to turn (a given age)

examples.en: Tomorrow I turn thirty.

meanings: rich, loaded

examples.en: After the inheritance he's loaded.

note: «Пара» is money. At Christmas it's a joke about whoever finds the coin in the «чесница» (festive bread).

meanings: to give generously
forms: literally: to give with full handfuls

examples.sr: Она [да̏је пу̏ним ша̏кама] свима око себе.
examples.en: She gives generously of herself to everyone around her.

meanings: to go abroad (colloq.)
forms: literally: to go over to the other side

examples.sr: Његов брат је [о̀тишао пре̏ко] пре десет година.
examples.en: His brother went abroad ten years ago.

note: In colloquial speech «преко» means 'abroad', especially for work and emigration.

meanings: I'm speechless (from admiration or outrage)

examples.en: Look at this, I'm speechless!

meanings: to side with no one, to sit on the fence

examples.sr: Он стоји по страни, [ни на̏шӣм ни ва̏шӣм].
examples.en: He stays on the sidelines, siding with no one.

note: About a neutral position: choosing neither side.
